snippet.title: Kuromaku – Official Gameplay Trailer | Psychological Thriller
snippet.description:
Kuromaku is a VHS-style psychological horror game inspired by Fears to Fathom and Chilla’s Art, where ordinary routines become your only defense against a creeping, unseen presence.

Left alone in a new house for the weekend, you must endure three nights of escalating tension as the familiar slowly begins to unravel. What you choose to do—and how you respond to the unknown—will shape how the story unfolds and which truth you are forced to confront.

Features

Play Your Way – Experience the game in its default presentation or with an optional VHS-style grain filter for a retro 1990s horror aesthetic.

Everyday Routines, Twisted – Cleaning, checking appliances, and running errands advance time while revealing unsettling signs that something is wrong.

Exploration & Discovery – Search rooms, examine objects, and uncover clues that peel back the layers of the mystery.

Player Choice Matters – Confront, conceal, or avoid the lurking presence. Every decision carries lasting consequences.

A Shifting Atmosphere – Time and mood transform the environment, turning the mundane into trials of psychological endurance.

Multiple Endings – Choices made across all three nights lead to different conclusions.

The main game is releasing soon.
▶ Play the Kuromaku demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3947910/Kuromaku/
